MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 4

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 17

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

12. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 19
   D. 8

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 36
   D. 18

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 44

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

24. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
